name: Theorem Target Selection and Strengthening Plan
purpose: Select and prepare high-priority local theorem candidates for formal strengthening.

selected_targets.name: Bounded Continuation Persistence Lemma
selected_targets.candidate_statement: A continuation structure can persist only while admissibility projection remains defined, transport flux remains finite, and local admissibility cost remains within declared budget tolerance.

selected_targets.name: Projectional Geometry Dependency Lemma
selected_targets.candidate_statement: Apparent geometry depends on stabilized accessibility topology over the orientation array and cannot be introduced as a primitive metric substrate.

selected_targets.name: Reconstruction Non-Uniqueness Lemma
selected_targets.candidate_statement: Distinct continuation histories may reconstruct into equivalent observable structures when compression loss erases discriminating structure.
proof_blockers: need equivalence relation over reconstructed states

selected_targets.name: Finite Budget Competition Lemma
selected_targets.candidate_statement: When competing continuation structures share finite admissibility budgets, arbitration outcomes must be preserved as possible outcomes.

phase_2_counterexample_obligations: Construct cases where persistence fails under undefined projection
Construct cases where persistence fails under unbounded flux
Construct cases where histories are distinct but observationally equivalent
